question: Among those mantras, what is said of the not-fierce aṇu that destroys great faults and has dark color?
premises: Among them is named a not-fierce aṇu.
inference: Among them, the not-fierce aṇu destroys great faults and is of dark color.
uncertainties: Identity of this aṇu-mantra in this list is uncertain without wider context.
plain_english: Among them, the not-fierce aṇu destroys great faults and has a dark color.
